"Are you going to hang popcorn on your tree?" Piglet asked. "There was popcorn," Pooh admitted. "But I ate it. Now I only have string." Pooh thought for a second, wondering if he was supposed to get more popcorn. But that wasn't it either. Then we can use the string to wrap the presents you're giving, Piglet said. Something began to tickle at Pooh's brain. It was the something missing that he hadn't been able to remember. I forgot to get presents, Pooh exclaimed. Don't worry, Pooh, Piglet said. Christopher Robin opened the door and smiled when he saw the visitor. Come in, Pooh Bear, he said. Merry Christmas. Why do you look so sad on the most wonderful night of the year? Pooh was just about to explain about the forgotten presents when something caught his eye. He pointed at the stockings over the fireplace. "What are those for?" he asked.
